tool.name: MdaHole
tool.description: : Wrapper of the MDAnalysis HOLE module for analyzing ion channel pores or transporter pathways.

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input CRD,GRO,MDCRD,MOL2,PDB,PDBQT,PRMTOP,PSF,TOP,TPR,XML,XYZ file
param.help: Path to the input structure or topology file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input ARC,CRD,DCD,ENT,GRO,INPCRD,MDCRD,MOL2,NC,PDB,PDBQT,RESTRT,TNG,TRR,XTC,XYZ file
param.help: Path to the input trajectory to be processed. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_hole_path
param.label: output VMD name
param.help: Path to the output HOLE analysis results Format: [output].vmd

param.name: outname_output_csv_path
param.label: output CSV name
param.help: Path to the output CSV file containing the radius and coordinates of the pore Format: [output].csv

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: select
param.label: select
param.help: The selection string to create an atom selection that the HOLE analysis is applied to.

param.name: cpoint
param.label: cpoint
param.help: Coordinates of a point inside the pore (Å). If None, tries to guess based on the geometry. (Json)

param.name: cvect
param.label: cvect
param.help: Search direction vector. If None, tries to guess based on the geometry. (Json)

param.name: sample
param.label: sample
param.help: Distance of sample points in Å. This value determines how many points in the pore profile are calculated.

param.name: end_radius
param.label: end_radius
param.help: Radius in Å, which is considered to be the end of the pore.

param.name: dot_density
param.label: dot_density
param.help: Density of facets for generating a 3D pore representation.
